[SWS_DM_02130] Access control on ara::diag interfaces
⌈
The Diagnostic Server instance shall restrict the processes that can interact
over any ara::diag interface only to the processes referenced by the corresponding
mapping in the role process in the manifest. Restriction means that no interaction with the initiating process shall be done and - if configured - a security event shall be
raised.
⌋
